identity.title: ALMA Survey of Orion Planck Galactic Cold Clumps (ALMASOP). I. Detection of New Hot Corinos with the ACA

paper_type_evidence.quote: The observations were carried out with the ACA, which is an interferometer composed of twelve 7-meter antennas.

question.value: Which Planck Galactic Cold Clump cores in Orion harbor hot corinos, and what are their COM, deuteration and carbon-chain chemical properties, using ACA 1.3 mm line data?

evidence.quote: We report the detection of four new hot corino sources, G211.47-19.27S, G208.68-19.20N1, G210.49-19.79W and G192.12-11.10 from a survey study of Planck Galactic Cold Clumps in the Orion Molecular Cloud Complex
They were conducted as a part of the ALMA Cycle 6 project, (#2018.1.00302.S; PI: Tie Liu)

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: Four SPWs at 216.6, 218.9, 231.0, 233.0 GHz; 1875 MHz each; ~1.129 MHz (~1.5 km/s) resolution

evidence.quote: Four spectral windows, centered at 216.6, 218.9, 231.0 and 233.0 GHz with an uniform bandwidth of 1875 MHz ($\sim$2500 km s$^{-1}$) and a resolution of $\sim$1.129 MHz
The observations were carried out with the ACA, which is an interferometer composed of twelve 7-meter antennas.
The longest baseline was 49 m, which was about 37.7 k$\lambda$.
The HPBW of the synthesized beam was $\sim$ 5.6${''}$
All the measurements were made in 2018.
ALMA Cycle 6 project, (#2018.1.00302.S; PI: Tie Liu)

findings_qualitative.value: COMs are unresolved and compact while hydrocarbons and carbon chains are resolved, tracing cooler envelopes

evidence.quote: The hydrocarbons and the carbon-chain molecules are resolved while saturated COMs are not

claims.hypothesis: Do four cores in the ALMASOP sample host hot corinos?
claims.experiment: Scan ACA spectra of 72 cores for rich lines incl. multiple CH3OH lines with Eu>100 K; model with XCLASS
claims.result: Four sources show compact CH3OH with Trot >165 K
claims.finding: G211, G208, G210, G192 are hot corinos

evidence.quote: the evidences we present suggest the four objects be hot corinos.

claims.hypothesis: Are COM ratios in these sources similar to other hot corinos?
claims.result: G211 and G208 ratios an order of magnitude higher, but comparable using 13CH3OH proxy
claims.finding: Differences possibly due to beam dilution and methanol opacity

evidence.quote: are an order of magnitude larger than the typical values in other hot corinos.

limitations_admitted.value: Resolution insufficient; column densities may be underestimated by beam dilution and opacity

evidence.quote: The estimated column densities could be affected by beam dilution since the COM emission is not resolved.
